title: Arcade Play Game
description: A Polyglot Arcade game with the player's best, the champion and how to play it, or the list of games to choose from.

hasGame.title: Has Game
hasGame.description: True when one game was found and is shown

hasBest.title: Has Best
hasBest.description: True when the player has scored in this game

bestScore.title: Best Score
bestScore.description: The best round of the person who asks

hasChampion.title: Has Champion
hasChampion.description: True when anyone has scored in this game

championScore.title: Champion Score
championScore.description: The best round of the champion

playableInChat.title: Playable in Chat
playableInChat.description: True when the game can be played in the conversation

hasPlayUrl.title: Has Play URL
hasPlayUrl.description: True when the game can be opened in the arcade

playUrl.title: Play URL
playUrl.description: Opens the game on the surface that saves its rounds

message.title: Message
message.description: Shown when the game was not found

hasOptions.title: Has Options
hasOptions.description: True when a list of games is shown to choose from

options.title: Options
options.description: Every game to choose from, when no single game was found
